$comment: Exceptions of `bun run i18n:scan`. paths: excluded path prefixes (from the project root), with the reason. strings: allowed exact strings (brands, proper nouns, formats). patterns: regular expressions (whole string). For a one-off exception, prefer the `// i18n-ignore <reason>` comment on the line (or the previous line).

paths.src/lib/demo/: demo dataset: French seed values by design, no user interface
paths.src/db/schema/: schema: technical values and comments (false positives)
paths.src/scripts/provision.ts: operations CLI (logs not translated, out of scope)
